prompt: Write a one-star review of the Liberty Bell from a man who drove eleven hours to see it.
response: I drove eleven hours for this. ELEVEN. HOURS. It’s just a busted metal pot with a glorified bad haircut running down the front. The thing doesn’t even ring—it’s literally famous for being a defective, non-functional failure. I’ve seen more impressive cracks in my windshield on the way here. The line to stare at this useless hunk of scrap was longer than the actual history behind it. I could’ve stayed home, smashed a flower pot, and gotten the same emotional experience without the $40 parking. Don’t waste the gas. Absolute joke.
